crossRefs.note: Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard.…

people.name: Ebed-melech
people.line: Ethiopian eunuch who rescued Jeremiah from a cistern

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took from there rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
translations.bsb: Then Ebed-melech took the men with him and went to the king’s palace, to a place below the storehouse. From there he took old rags and worn-out clothes and lowered them with ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern.
translations.kjv: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
translations.asv: So Ebed-melech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
